title: Mark Lee Wants to Convey ‘the Greatest Love’ Through His New Song ‘My Friend’
summary: "This is exactly the music I should be putting out as my present self," the K-pop star tells Billboard Korea.
contentText:
Five months after his departure from SM Entertainment and NCT , Mark has returned as singer-songwriter Mark Lee with his new single, “My Friend.”

“The new tracks I’m working on right now take completely unexpected directions and styles,” he tells Billboard Korea . “But I’ve gained the conviction that this is exactly the music I should be putting out as my present self.”

The new single, “My Friend,” is a mid-tempo track driven by a breezy guitar loop. It captures a refreshing and laid-back mood, leaving a lingering sense of nostalgia as summer draws to a close.

Over the past decade, Mark has built an impressive career as a K-pop powerhouse, undergoing five debuts, two permanent groups and numerous unit projects. He is arguably the only artist in K-pop history to have pulled off such an extensive and diverse resume.

Shedding the image of his long-standing group promotions with the release of his first solo album, The Firstfruit , in 2025, he proved his prowess as a solo artist by securing the No. 1 spot on Billboard ’s 25 Best K-Pop Albums of 2025 : Staff Picks.

“I want to make music for a long time,” Mark shares regarding his future aspirations. “Being fiercely competitive isn’t necessarily the goal anymore. Instead, I want to do my absolute best to spread a positive influence through both my music and my life.”

Keep reading for his Q&A with Billboard Korea .

You’ve wrapped up 10 fierce years of group life and become independent as a singer-songwriter. Through your vlogs, you’ve also shared your ordinary daily life in New York, rather than as an artist. How did the changes in your environment, both in your daily life and musically, influence the work on your new song?

I think my new challenge has changed so many things. Not only the environment, but musically, too — I feel like I’ve taken on a truly new challenge. Through this, I feel like my mindset has properly settled as a full-fledged singer-songwriter for the first time. That’s why, more than any other project, I worked a lot on the melodies and the vocal aspects. I’ve really loved singing since I was young. [ Laughs ] I feel like I’m finally expressing that passion in a 360-way now.

Since your previous group promotions, you’ve always strived to show the public your best and utmost efforts. As this is your first new song in a while, the pressure during the preparation process must have been significant. What kind of mindset did you have while preparing?

I’ll take that as a compliment!! I think that ever since I was young, my natural tendency has always been to do my absolute best whenever something is entrusted to me. And because of that, I think I usually kind of stress over my work a lot.

I actually had a lot of worries and pressure while preparing for this new music, and figuring out which direction to take was my most difficult concern. But as I worked on various things and as different tracks began to come to life, these musical results actually gave me the confidence I needed, and it felt like they were resolving my worries already.

Including “My Friend,” all the songs I’ve recently worked on were the results of totally unexpected directions and styles, but I gained the conviction that this is exactly the “music” I need to release as my current self. Nevertheless, the pressure is still big in my heart, but I personally truly like my new music. I just want to share it with the world.

If your first solo album, The Firstfruit , showed the journey of your past life, this new song, “My Friend,” seems to foreshadow the direction of the life you want to pursue going forward. What are the life goals and dreams that singer-songwriter Mark Lee wants to achieve in the future?

Hats off to you for that observation! [ Laughs ] I don’t think I even thought about it to that extent, but I think you’re right! It’s a song that opens the first door to my new chapter, and I also consider it a taste of my upcoming album. Throughout the year, I’m planning to showcase more of my music from my upcoming project, and as the album tracks gradually reveal themselves, I believe that my side as a singer-songwriter will become more apparent. My goal for the future is to keep making music and to best express stories that can be a positive influence to the world.

View this post on Instagram

While the music and performances you showed during your group activities were thrilling and exciting, bursting fans’ dopamine, singer-songwriter Mark Lee’s music comes across as comforting and moving in contrast. What kind of emotion did you want to give fans through “My Friend”?

It’s not that I’m only trying to do emotional music, but I’d like to say that in my totally biased opinion … the style and music of this album personally gives me both a dopamine rush and feels very moving at the same time. [ Laughs ] If there’s one difference that’s definitely noticeable, it’s how much I’ve tried to express myself vocally. Since I haven’t challenged myself this much as a vocalist before, I’m actually a bit worried, but even that is part of who I am right now. I believe the new music I’m presenting will contribute to “completing the present Mark Lee.” Through “My Friend,” I hope my feelings about an everlasting, greatest love will be conveyed as a warm and soft emotion.

The lyrics of “My Friend” seem to be the words you want to convey to your fans the most. Even the term referring to your fans, “Markf,” is short for “Mark Friend.” In this song where your sincerity and the fans are all connected as one, which lyrics do you most want to resonate with your fans?

Actually, I worked on the lyrics for “My Friend” multiple times. Even the theme was different at first, and the name of the song was different, too. But once I knew that this song should be about the theme of “the greatest love,” the name “friend” became a very special name to me. The lyric “My Friend” became a name I wish to sing to the world, hoping it will be filled with love, and since the fans were already “Mark Friends” to me, I hope the song “My Friend” becomes a special track for everyone. [ Laughs ]

The musical skills you’ve consistently proven as an NCT member are also evident in the credits. You are listed for lyrics, composition and even arrangement. Since it’s your first single after becoming independent, it must hold more affection and meaning for you. What was the process of making “My Friend” like, and were there any particularly memorable moments?

It’s definitely a song I have a lot of affection for. Actually, I already have a lot of affection for my entire album this time… haha While making “My Friend,” working on the lyrics multiple times is what stands out in my memory the most. I’m the type to pray a lot in between making music, [ laughs ] and this was a song I particularly prayed a lot for. I even remember finalizing and revising the lyrics right up until the final recording moment.

In the music video for “My Friend,” we see you in nature — warm sunshine, green meadows — without any AI or VFX effects. Unlike K-pop music videos that pursue more maximalist and flashy visuals, this music video felt much more minimal, like things had been “stripped back.” This seems to align with the attitude toward life you pursue.
